epics.title: Reproducible local workspace and fast checks
Media ownership and compatible public workflow
Integrated evidence and local release readiness

issues.title: Define epics, persona stories, issue contracts and waves
acceptance: Versioned plan maps UC-1–UC-7, proposal targets, dependencies and ownership to executable issues.
One GitHub Project contains native epic/sub-issue and blocking relationships with stable keys.
Multi-issue PR groups, review gates, resource isolation and stop conditions are explicit.
verification: Validate backlog dependency DAG and unique stable keys.
Fresh gh reads verify project and issue hierarchy.

issues.title: Independently review and correct the delivery plan
acceptance: GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh reviews complete planning package and records findings.
Every substantive finding has a disposition and fix or explicit evidence-backed limitation.
No implementation wave starts before the corrected plan passes review.
verification: Review verdict and finding-to-fix matrix under docs/execution/reviews/.

issues.title: Install a reproducible root workspace with Make and environment doctor
acceptance: make setup installs locked Python and frontend dependencies locally without overwriting existing secrets.
make help, doctor, lint, test and clean commands work from root; external prerequisites have precise diagnostics.
Worktree caches/artifacts/secrets are ignored; commands never require cd Media_player.
verification: make setup && make doctor && make lint && make test
Run setup twice; preserve configured .env and test tracked-tree cleanliness.

issues.title: Establish fast deterministic test tiers and required CI checks
acceptance: Fast suite needs no network/services and targets <=30s warm locally; CI fast job targets <=3min excluding runner queue.
Real integration/e2e suites have isolated resources, bounded polling, stable fixtures, no blind sleeps or retry-to-green masking.

Enforce combined statement/branch coverage >=80% separately for each live backend/helper/CLI package, including unexecuted production files; report raw branch rates separately. Keep legacy app regression gate and all four frontend >=90% thresholds. New package arrivals must extend lint/coverage/CI selections.
CI always reports required fast/integration status; expensive scans/builds are cached/separate; failures remain visible.

Retain existing Trivy zero-fixable-HIGH/CRITICAL release policy for every distinct live Media/Processing/worker image digest; legacy app scan alone is insufficient. Reuse scan tooling without broader security infrastructure.
verification: make test repeated three times with recorded durations
make coverage and GitHub check results on exact PR SHA.

issues.title: Provide isolated local services, storage and trusted HTTPS topology
acceptance: make up starts fresh project-owned services with separate databases, Redis and local S3-compatible storage; make down preserves data.

Project-local TLS endpoint is reachable with explicit CA trust in host/container/test clients; Secure-cookie end-to-end login is verified in V1 after Media integration. No system trust-store changes or disabled certificate verification.
Public/internal source and playback hostnames resolve in their respective runtimes; no secrets are tracked.
Two worktree stacks can use distinct projects/ports/volumes; resource preflight reports Docker CPU/memory limits.
Pinned MinIO build or locally verified compatible image works from fresh cache; fetch GitHub sources through gh.
Bounded project-local capacity investigation determines whether >=8CPU/8GiB can support fair worker quotas without global Docker changes; record feasibility before evidence wave.

make browser-trust-smoke runs pinned Playwright Firefox with the local CA imported into a project-local temporary NSS profile using certutil. Verification remains enabled; trusted HTTPS navigation succeeds and an unrelated-CA control fails. Certificate SANs cover public API and media hostnames.
verification: make up && make smoke-infra && make down
Fresh-volume boot and two isolated stacks; no shared volume destruction.
make browser-trust-smoke (real Firefox, trusted positive and untrusted negative; no insecure flags).

issues.title: Implement attempt lifecycle, stored-source retry and cancellation
acceptance: Job/Attempt transitions use reserved attempt IDs and conditional fences; only current live attempt may publish.
Retry from failed records stable retry_request_id and returns prior attempt on replay; other states/owners rejected.
Cancel by AssetId serializes with submit, retains tombstone, and prevents delayed resurrection in both race orders.
Own migration history is additive and independent of media_db.
verification: make test-processing
Real Postgres concurrent submit/retry/cancel and stale completion tests.

issues.title: Run attempt-aware FFmpeg workers with private source and output access
acceptance: Queue payload carries job_id and attempt_id; worker claims once and reuses existing FFmpeg behavior.
Worker downloads via renewable presigned source access with revision/digest validation; it has no MM database or source-storage credential.
Primary MP4 and best-effort HLS publish under attempt-specific keys; valid inherited MKV/MP3 edits remain compatible.
Real short fixture completes into playable output; stale attempts never replace winning output.

Lease supervisor spans download/encode/upload, terminates the process group on lease loss, and fences stale success AND failure. HLS fallback must not swallow cancellation; total attempt budget covers all stages.
verification: make test-processing && make integration-processing
Real FFmpeg MP4/HLS/fallback and stale-output tests.

issues.title: Recover worker interruptions and lost queue deliveries
acceptance: Independent heartbeat supervises encoding; dead worker is failed within5min and healthy long encoding stays live.
Durable queued attempts recover missing RQ delivery within2min, including lingering RQ metadata.
Reconciler reuses reserved attempts; bounded retries/backoff and Processing-only output cleanup are observable.
Killing a worker, then retrying from stored source succeeds without duplicate published output.
Cleanup remains repeatable through late uploads after cancellation; never delete source objects or active/winning output prefixes.
verification: make integration-processing
Fault injection with deadlines and sanitized job/attempt evidence.

issues.title: Create Media-owned Assets and durable idempotent submission
acceptance: Media database owns users, immutable source descriptors, Assets, request keys and pending intent; no Processing tables/imports.
Upload/edit Idempotency-Key preserves one Asset; source size/type/owner validated before acceptance and source replay is immutable.
Submit uses authenticated HTTP and prepared contract; temporary P failure preserves durable pending intake.
Reverse source-access endpoint renews signed URLs only for matching owner/revision/live Asset.
verification: make test-media
Real Postgres owner/request-key isolation and pending restart tests.

issues.title: Serve compatible status, retry and authorised MP4/HLS playback
acceptance: Existing web routes retain public Asset IDs; submitted status is composed from live owner-filtered P reads.
Pending maps queued/pending without outputs; dependency outage or missing linked P job returns503.
Stored-source retry delegates with stable request ID and does not upload again.
Owner-only MP4 URLs and HLS manifests/segments work across local HTTPS/storage topology, including inherited formats.
verification: make test-media
API compatibility + HLS/primary playback tests against controlled Processing boundary.

issues.title: Reconcile pending submissions and preserve edit/delete/operator behavior
acceptance: Pending work survives MM restart and recovers after P outage without duplicate jobs.
Derived edits keep an independent source and immutable operations across replay and parent deletion.
Delete commits local tombstone then cancels P by AssetId even after lost submit response; repeatable cleanup deletes only owned objects.
Inherited owner/operator list/delete behaviors remain compatible; no new admin product features.
verification: make integration-media
Lost-response, pending restart, cancel race and derived edit lifecycle tests.

issues.title: Build the independent Publisher CLI against public APIs
acceptance: CLI register/login, folder publish, per-file outcome/status, playback access and stored-source retry use only public API/cookie session.
No service-code imports or DB credentials; bounded polls/timeouts and meaningful exit codes for partial batch failure.
JSON output is machine readable; passwords/tokens excluded from output; actual implementation effort and size recorded.
verification: make test-cli against controlled public-contract responses
Inspect imports/dependencies; live mixed-success batch and stored-source retry are V1 acceptance after both backends integrate.

issues.title: Complete browser stored-source retry and idempotent requests
acceptance: Browser retry invokes failed job retry endpoint and never resends remembered video.
Uploads/edits/retries use stable request IDs for transport replay; repeated user actions remain intentional new requests.
Pending/error503 states remain understandable; preserve existing design/editor behavior and roadmap visuals.
verification: make test-frontend
Browser network assertions for retry with unchanged source and no upload request.

issues.title: Integrate full local workflow and contract regression evidence
acceptance: Fresh make up supports browser registration/upload/process/status/playable MP4/HLS/stored-source retry/owner deletion; CLI proves register/login, mixed-success folder publish, per-file outcomes, status, authorised output access and stored-source retry. No CLI media player or delete feature is required.
All25 prepared contract cases have implemented tests or specific evidence-backed disposition; all required basic negative/ownership cases pass.
A real browser checks login, upload, playback and retry; accessible frontend unchanged except needed behavior.
No direct cross-service DB/storage ownership shortcuts or service imports in CLI.
verification: make verify-local && make e2e
Review CT mapping with exact test names and raw outputs.

issues.title: Exercise recovery faults across both services
acceptance: Inject worker kill, lost queue item with surviving metadata, and P outage during upload.
Recovery timing meets <=5min worker visible failure and <=2min re-enqueue; retries succeed without duplicate published output.
Record actual states, job/attempt IDs, timings and reproducible commands; failures are not hidden.
verification: make evidence-recovery

issues.title: Measure local performance and worker scaling without misleading claims
acceptance: Run status polling50users/3min p90<=700ms,<1%errors; separate20login p90<2s, retaining raw data.
Implement and run30identical60s720p clips at1/2/3 workers,2vCPU each when host has capacity; record throughput/queue/processing/errors/CPU/memory.
Targets2workers>=1.6x,3workers>=2.1x and falling median queuewait,zero failures remain visible with pass/fail and resource preflight.

If current sandbox cannot support fair quotas, complete runner and bounded local pilot, label exact limitation, and investigate project-local runtime without global setting changes. Never count oversubscribed results as acceptance.
verification: make evidence-performance && make evidence-scaling
Resource manifest, hashes, raw timings and computed target table.

issues.title: Automate independent local Processing release, smoke and rollback
acceptance: Build/version per-service images; release candidate Processing independently and smoke-test within10min.
MM container identity/image and media_db migration revision remain unchanged; workers drain or fail visibly within bounded time.
Injected bad candidate fails promotion, rolls back to prior tested image and recovers smoke.
Scripts are local-only, repeatable and record exact images/migrations/timestamps; no AWS credentials or actions.
Exact candidate image digest has passing build/test and inherited zero-fixable-HIGH/CRITICAL scan evidence before promotion. A failed scan blocks promotion; shared API/worker digest needs one scan.
verification: make evidence-release

issues.title: Review final delivery and publish evidence-based morning handoff
acceptance: Prerequisites: V2/V4 complete and V3 assessed with full scaling evidence OR a reproducible runner/pilot plus documented capacity blocker. Independent Sol review checks code/issues/evidence; fix substantive in-scope findings.

Final Main checks pass; accepted grouped PRs merge and metadata matches evidence. V3 and E5 remain open if full UC-6 scaling acceptance lacks fair-capacity evidence; final handoff may complete while explicitly stating that limitation.
Handoff file gives exact start/stop/test commands, URLs, credentials location (no values), architecture decisions, PR/issue map, results and limitations.
Report/demo evidence source pack distinguishes inherited/new work and local/cloud evidence; list future AWS prerequisites only, do not provision.
verification: make verify-local
Independent review and gh fresh-read reconciliation.
